spec.description: J4 of llm-dlc/loops/application-core-acceptance.md, Phase 5 step 4 of llm-dlc/loops/application-core.md, at the commit that carries this job (the merged revision with every Phase 5 piece so far). The reuse stream ran this benchmark (lib/tests/preparation.rs, ignored inline) at its own commit 283aa75d in job 20261108-114325, which passed; its report lib/benchmark/preparation/j4.json stays as recorded. Since then the four streams merged and the library changed in 33 files of lib/src (compare --domains, String and list adapters, receivers with dependencies, literals by code units, and more); the benchmark changed by one line only (Options gained domains: Default::default()). This job runs the identical step on the merged revision and writes j4-merge.json and .md beside the stream's report. Cases on the joint example's builds (lib/tests/fixtures/foundations, examples 190 and 191, and lib/tests/fixtures/preparation's overlays): a cold run of after, an unchanged rerun, an unrelated edit (a class nothing reaches), a safe helper rewrite (Pricing.discount), and the real defect offset cold and rerun; preparation, solving and replay (after the runs: the witness replayed, shrunk and run on a JVM) timed apart, medians of 7, release. Native engine only, the fixture's bounds (unwind 16, arrays up to 8); no JBMC. A debug smoke run inline (1 repeat, 61 s) passed with the stream's verdicts and cache outcomes.
spec.expected: The step exits 0 (the process status), and the benchmark's assertions hold, which are its verdicts: every repeat and the process reach the same verdicts; under after, unrelated-edit and helper-rewrite the route POST /quotes and Pricing#total, #withQuantity and #discount verified, POST /quotes/text unresolved, Money#cents and Quote#quantity unchecked; under offset the route and total refuted; the reruns and the unrelated edit prove nothing again; in the helper rewrite total is proved again on a new proof of discount (a key other than the cold run's), the helper's own proof a miss, withQuantity an exact hit. The report has six scenarios. The figures are for these fixtures only.
